(New Revised) In-Game Rules

Last Updated: November 17, 2025
First Updated: December 02, 2025
Second revision: March 10, 2026
Release Date: November 24, 2025
- All punishments proceed after one warning and step.

1. Reverse driving ban (35-day Van >> 45-day Van)
2. Speeding ban [Speed limit above 65km/h] (5-day van / 10-day van above 75km/h)
B 2.1. In the case of the BRT, speed limit from 85 km/h or more is allowed as an overspeed according to the special law on expressway traffic.
B 2.2. Except for the routes specified by the Eastern Region Bureau as BRT (Interline Rapid Transit Wide Area Line), the speed limit of 85 km/h does not apply to special cases.
3. Counter-Driving and Threat-Driving Ban (14-day Van) If the situation is severe, existing punishment day + 3-day multiple punishment
4. Bug Exploit Ban (10-Day Van)
5. Gamepass and slot vehicle confiscation ban (15-day van)
6. No Traffic Violation (30-Day Van)
